page.title: Switching to Vireek
page.subtitle: A guided checklist for moving customers, jobs and billing history from your old system — checked against real numbers, not hopes.
page.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this page
page.noAccessBody: Migration is restricted to the account owner and members who can edit the business profile.

export_data.title: Export your data from the old system
export_data.body: Export customers, jobs and (if you want billing history) invoices, line items, payments and equipment as CSV or Excel. Keep the ID column in every file — it is what makes re-imports safe.

freeze_window.title: Agree a cut-over date and a change freeze
freeze_window.body: Pick the day the team stops entering new work in the old system. Anything created after your export has to be re-exported or entered by hand.

control_totals.title: Write down the old system’s control totals
control_totals.body: From reports in the old system, note the record counts and money totals (job revenue, invoices, payments, open balance). You enter them below and Vireek compares them to what was imported, to the cent.

invite_team.title: Invite your team
invite_team.body: Add dispatchers, technicians and office staff so they can look at their imported customers and jobs before cut-over.

import_customers.title: Import customers
import_customers.body: Run the customer import first. Jobs and invoices link to customers through the old system’s customer ID.

import_jobs.title: Import job history
import_jobs.body: Run the jobs import after customers so every job can be linked to its customer.

import_ledger.title: Import invoices, line items and payments
import_ledger.body: Optional. Import all three so invoice totals can be checked against their lines and payments. This step completes only when all three have finished.

import_equipment.title: Import equipment
import_equipment.body: Optional. Installed equipment is linked to customers by the old system’s customer ID.

connect_price_book.title: Connect or build your price book
connect_price_book.body: Connect the old system’s price book where supported, or enter your prices, so quotes and calls use your real numbers.

connect_accounting.title: Connect accounting
connect_accounting.body: Optional. Connect QuickBooks so new invoices and payments flow to your books. Historical invoices come from the ledger import, not from QuickBooks.

validation_clean.title: Post-import validation has no failures or warnings
validation_clean.body: Every check in the validation report below passes.

review_duplicates.title: Review possible duplicate customers
review_duplicates.body: Customers that share an email, a phone number or a name and address with an imported customer. Merge or correct them in Customers.

review_unmatched.title: Resolve unmatched records
review_unmatched.body: Jobs, invoices or payments that could not be linked to a customer, job or invoice — usually a missing or changed ID in the export.

money_reconciled.title: Money reconciles to the old system
money_reconciled.body: Job revenue, invoice total, payments and open balance match the control totals exactly. Enter the control totals to enable this check.

spot_check.title: Spot-check records side by side
spot_check.body: Open at least ten customers and ten jobs in both systems and compare names, addresses, phone numbers, dates and amounts.

phone_forwarding.title: Point your business number at Vireek
phone_forwarding.body: Forward or port your business line so calls reach Sarah. Do this when the team is ready, not before.

parallel_run.title: Run both systems in parallel
parallel_run.body: Keep the old system read-only for a short, agreed period and compare daily totals before relying on Vireek alone.

cutover_day.title: Cut over
cutover_day.body: From the agreed time, all new work is entered in Vireek only. Re-run the import for anything created since the export.

train_team.title: Train the team
train_team.body: Owner, dispatcher and technician courses walk through the real screens each role uses.

old_system_readonly.title: Make the old system read-only
old_system_readonly.body: Keep the export files and read-only access until your finance and tax needs are met. Check contract and data-retention terms with your advisor before cancelling.

week1_review.title: Week-one review
week1_review.body: Re-run the validation report, review import history and open items, and fix what the team ran into.

report.title: Post-import validation report
report.subtitle: Counts, unmatched records, duplicates and money totals for imports from this source.
report.emptyTitle: Nothing imported from this source yet
report.emptyBody: Run an import first, then come back to validate it.

checks.rows_accounted: Every {{entity}} row in the last import is accounted for (created + updated + skipped + errors = rows in file)
checks.matches_source: Rows in the {{entity}} file match the old system’s count
checks.present_in_account: Created {{entity}} are still in your account
checks.unmatched_jobs_without_customer: Imported jobs not linked to a customer
checks.unmatched_invoices_without_customer: Imported invoices not linked to a customer
checks.unmatched_invoices_without_job: Invoices that reference a job that was not found
checks.unmatched_payments_without_invoice: Payments not linked to an invoice
checks.money_invoice_lines_dont_add_up: Invoices whose lines do not add up to their total

control.title: Control totals from the old system
control.body: Type the numbers from a report in your old system. US format, e.g. 12,345.60. Leave a field empty to skip that comparison.
